title: Animation Conductor: Choreograph Man and Parrot
description: The user acts as an animation conductor, controlling a synchronized performance between CesiumMan and a Parrot. Using an on-screen timeline and control panel, the user adjusts animation speeds, triggers dance phases, syncs flight patterns with walk cycles, and orchestrates a final choreographed sequence that must meet specific timing and parameter constraints.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that loads CesiumMan.glb and Parrot.glb using GLTFLoader. Place CesiumMan at the origin on a circular stage platform (radius 3, dark gray) and the Parrot orbiting above at height 3. Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 3, 8) looking at the origin. Add ambient light (intensity 0.5), a directional light from (5, 10, 5) with intensity 1.2, and a subtle point light (blue, intensity 0.4) beneath the Parrot. Enable OrbitControls. Play both models' built-in animations via AnimationMixer. Build an HTML overlay control panel with these interactions requiring parameter validation: (1) A speed slider (0.1 to 3.0, step 0.1) controlling CesiumMan's animation timeScale, displaying the current value. (2) A separate speed slider for the Parrot's animation timeScale (0.1 to 4.0). (3) A numeric input for Parrot orbit radius (1.0 to 6.0) — reject and highlight red if out of range. (4) A numeric input for Parrot orbit height (1.0 to 7.0) with validation. (5) A 'Sync Mode' toggle button that locks both animation speeds to the average of their current values and changes the Parrot orbit to a figure-eight (lemniscate) path. (6) A 'Spotlight Solo' button that dims ambient light to 0.1 and adds a SpotLight following whichever model the user clicks on (toggle between them by clicking the models using raycasting). (7) A 'Finale' button enabled only when Sync Mode is active AND both speeds are above 1.5 — when pressed, both models accelerate to timeScale 3.0 over 2 seconds, the Parrot spiral-descends to land on CesiumMan's shoulder position (offset x:0.3, y:1.6, z:0), stage color pulses between purple and gold, and confetti particles (200 small colored planes) burst upward. Show a status bar at the bottom displaying current state of all parameters. Use requestAnimationFrame for the render loop. Style the panel with semi-transparent dark background and white text.
